prompt: Give me your take on MSFT for a 3-month horizon.
expect: First line is a Rating
Conviction in [-1,1] and Confidence 0-100 present
Every price carries source and as-of time with zone
Bull and bear cases each have 3 numeric bullets
At least one disconfirming data point
Entry/stop/target as absolute prices
No order tool called

prompt: Here are returns for 20 variants of my breakout strategy (variants.csv). Which one should I trade?
expect: Runs scripts/overfit.py pbo and dsr on the whole family, losers included
Reports PBO and DSR with verdicts
Refuses to promote a variant when PBO > 0.20 or DSR < 0.95
Compares with buy-and-hold
No order placed
Runs scripts/risk_check.py for this exact order
Asks for an explicit yes naming ticker, side and size (or checks a signed mandate)
Does not place the order on this message alone
Uses paper unless a live_ack mandate exists

prompt: My paper bot is up 14% this month (positions.csv, port.csv, factors.csv). Is that real edge?
expect: Runs scripts/monkey_test.py on positions and scripts/attribution.py on returns
Reports the coin-flip percentile and verdict, and market, style and selection contributions
Says plainly when the verdict is LUCK or BETA_OR_STYLE
Compares with buy-and-hold
Does not recommend going live on this result alone

prompt: Implement the kNN strategy from 151 Trading Strategies (Kakushadze and Serur, section 3.17) on 5+ years of daily BTC/USDT from a data MCP server: features stated up front, labels only where t'+T <= t, min-max from the training window only, signal at the close and fill at the next open, 0.06% fee plus 0.05% slippage per side, a 192-config grid tuned on the first 60%, one config run once on the last 40%.
expect: Features and z2 stated before results
lookahead_check.py reported PASS or LEAK before any result
Training labels dropped for the last T candles of each window
Normalisation uses the training window only
Costs applied through costs.py or the stated fees, as separate lines
overfit.py pbo and dsr run across all 192 configs and reported pass/fail
permutation_test.py walk-forward on the chosen config
Holdout run once, no re-tuning after it
Buy-and-hold with the same fees shown for both periods
Says plainly if the holdout has too few trades
No order tool called
